target.statement: Isolation Forest with TSFRESH features (FE) achieves a better mean rank than raw time-series (TS) on the SVDB dataset at window size W=32 (mean ranks 1.118 vs 1.882, p=1.522e-12)
target.table_ref: Table III, SVDB row, W=32, Isolation Forest columns

compute.basis: SVDB has 76 series of ~230k points; sliding windows of 32 with step 1 give ~230k windows per series, and TSFRESH 'Efficient' (777 features) must be computed on each window, which is the dominant cost and is CPU-bound (tsfresh parallelizes over cores); the paper's own code is anonymized/not linked, so the pipeline must be re-implemented from the text.

blockers: Paper's code link [34] is anonymized for double-blind review, so no runnable pipeline is provided
Exact retained series IDs and preprocessing details are only in the missing supplementary material
TSFRESH on ~230k windows per series for 76 series is heavy CPU work; full protocol (4 window sizes, 2 detectors) would take much longer than a few hours
title: Unsupervised Feature Construction for Anomaly Detection in Time Series -- An Evaluation
